limits: Mobile measurements use the same Intel UHD and an emulated 390px viewport, not a physical phone.
Cold first-gesture frame spikes remain in the recorded timing; median FPS does not imply every frame meets budget.
Hidden supports, unmeasured stair/platform/tower dimensions and facade master artwork require field/brand confirmation.
Preview is loopback-only, not deployed production or a remote staging URL.
confirmedTerrainCause: Different recursive triangulations interpolated the nonlinear terrace differently, crossing nominally separated ground layers. Common world Z contour strips retain parallel 4cm spacing; verified over >250 points and the same orbit.

rejectedExperiment.result: Did not remove the timing spike and exceeded 5s. Removed from delivered code. Experiment video kept locally under final-auto-desktop.webm.
